channel.title: ZISHU TRON INSIGHT
channel.description: The official publishing platform of ZISHU TRON. Product announcements, engineering deep dives, and company updates.

item.title: Zishu IDE: Build Android Apps on Your Phone
item.description: Zishu IDE is a code editor and build tool for Android. Write Java or Kotlin, build an APK on your phone, sign it and install it, with no computer.

item.title: Zishu Terminal: A Real Linux Environment on Android
item.description: Zishu Terminal 6.0.0 turns an ordinary Android phone into a working Linux command-line workstation, with no root access and no emulator. It installs real bash, Python, Git, Node.js and a C/C++ compiler, and it adds a signed package manager so you can install more.

item.title: ZShoot V4 Is Here: The Biggest Update Yet
item.description: Aim, shoot and survive. Climb 9 ranks, 100 levels and rule the leaderboard.

item.title: 🚀 Zishu Deep AI v5.0.0: The Era of Native Power Begins
item.description: Zishu Deep AI v5.0.0 — The Ultimate Native AI Workspace Experience lightning-fast performance with our fully rebuilt Native Android app! Bring your own API keys (BYOK), generate AI images, write and run HTML/CSS/JS code with live preview, and enjoy seamless voice-to-text. No WebView, no lag—just pure, private, & power.

item.title: Zishu AI v2.0.0.2: A Major Evolution Toward a More Integrated Android AI Assistant
item.description: Zishu AI Version 2 introduces a major step forward in the evolution of ZISHU TRON's AI assistant. Building on the foundation of Version 1, the new release brings Android Default AI Assistant integration, an improved assistant interface, and a more convenient way to interact with AI directly from your smartphone.

item.title: ZShoot Official Website
item.description: ZShoot 3 is here, and it comes with its own official website. Explore the new shop, 18 guns, 18 worlds and a 30 day reward calendar, play the free web demo, download the APK, and tell the developer what to build next. https://zshoot.zishuai.cloud/

item.description: ZISHU DEEP AI v4.0 is a next-generation AI workspace built by ZISHU TRON. Chat naturally, write and debug code, research the web with real sources, analyze documents, generate images, and listen to replies — all in one clean, fast interface.

item.title: Stardust Discord Bot
item.description: Stardust is a fully-featured Discord infrastructure platform that brings moderation, automation, tickets, economy, leveling, giveaways, and community tools together under one unified dashboard. Built for server owners who want professional-grade control without the complexity.

item.title: Zishu Terminal (Beta) New Update
item.description: Zishu Terminal v5.6.5-beta.1 — a lightweight, developer-focused Android terminal built entirely from scratch. Real shell, real encryption, real GitHub cloning, real clipboard management. No root. No fake features. No compromises. Built on classic Android (android.app.Activity, no AndroidX, no Kotlin)

item.title: Zishu Terminal (Beta) v5.6.5
item.description:
What's new in v5.6.5-beta.1:
• Added zgit clone — download public GitHub repos as snapshots • Fixed binary output rendering (cat on encrypted files now shows instantly) • zrun now detects shebang and uses the correct interpreter • zrun path resolution fixed (absolute, relative, ~, $HOME) • Added verbose mode to zrun

item.title: Zishu Terminal (Beta) v5.5.0
item.description: Zishu Terminal v5.5.0-beta.1 — Built-in curl with real HTTPS, AES-256 file encryption (zprotect), and improved server. Beta.
